title: Environment variable set from variable data (c)
description: The code sets an environment variable with putenv. The string is not copied, and a value containing a separator can change how later library loads and child processes behave. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks the value source.
remediation: Set only constant environment entries, or validate the value against a strict pattern, for example setenv with a validated constant value.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without tracing the value.
